thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — elevated 5xx and tail latency observed in eu-west-3 affecting Hosted API and multiple Dedicated GPU pools. Third-party egress to AWS STS/KMS showing spikes. Paging SRE oncall. :rotating_light:

oncall-ryan: Seeing ~12% 5xx on /v1/generate in eu-west-3 over the last 5m, p95 latency up from 120ms -> 860ms. Auto-retries bumping client traffic.

sre-anna: Acknowledged. Pulling logs and checking outbound egress to sts.amazonaws.com and kms.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com.

infra-ben: Cloud provider status page shows partial degradation for eu-west-3 STS egress in some AZs: https://status.aws.amazon.com (note: we saw similar last month).

oncall-ryan: Quick impact estimate: hosted API errors concentrated in eu-west-3 edge and dedicated pools pinned to eu-west-3. Customer p95 latency for those routes increased, ~5 customers reported timeouts in last 10m.

product-zoe: Customer Impact: a handful of mid-market customers on Dedicated reported elevated error rates on token auth flows. They're asking for ETA on fix.

support-luis: Logged tickets for impacted customers and added incident link. Customers notified: "We are investigating an external dependency causing auth failures; temporary retries/fallbacks enabled."

infra-ben: Running quick curl from control-plane host to STS endpoint:
```
curl -v https://sts.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com/ -H 'X-Amz-Date: <ts>'
* Connected to sts.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com (52.XX.XX.XX) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake complete
> POST / HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
```

sre-anna: KV: STS egress showing increased connection resets and long TLS handshake times. KMS similar for decrypt calls. Root cause likely upstream egress or intermediate NAT/ISP overload.

oncall-ryan: Mitigation plan: 1) Apply routing bypass to prefer eu-west-1 STS for control-plane token refresh (non-customer-data operations) 2) For Dedicated customer routes, enable short-lived fallback tokens cached in region to reduce STS calls 3) Engage cloud provider support and verify we can reroute egress through another NAT gateway.

infra-ben: I can flip control-plane to use eu-west-1 STS for non-sensitive control-plane ops—pushing a config now (will validate).

deploy-bot: deploy started by infra-ben: config/controlplane/sts-fallback -> canary (1/3 hosts).

support-luis: Note: please include comms templates for customers that ask for more details. I'll coordinate messages.

product-zoe: Prioritize Dedicated customers with pinned eu-west-3 pools. We should consider emergency capacity relocation if degradation persists >30m.

oncall-ryan: Quick commands for diagnosis if you join:
```
# check edge->sts error rate
kubectl logs -l app=edge-proxy -n hosted --since=10m | grep sts.eu-west-3 | egrep "timeout|reset|504" | wc -l
# trace tcp latency to sts from control plane
sudo tcptraceroute sts.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com 443
```

sre-anna: Canary looks good for control-plane calls after switching to eu-west-1 for non-customer token refresh. Observability: 5xx down to ~4% (still elevated). P95 latency dropping to ~300ms.

oncall-ryan: I'm enabling region-level fallback routing policy for inference traffic: allow routing to eu-west-1 variant for read-only model variants and non-customer pinned traffic. Applying now.

infra-ben: Routed dedicated pool healthcheck to alternate NAT in eu-west-1 for control-plane. KMS decrypt traffic still shows intermittent 504s — opening ticket with AWS with trace IDs.

support-luis: Customers updated with current mitigation steps and estimated TTR: 45–90 minutes depending on upstream recovery.

product-zoe: Requesting SLO impact calc: baseline errors for eu-west-3 for last hour vs rolling 7d. Will attach to postmortem.

oncall-ryan: Handoff: I need to go offline in 20m. @sre-anna you take primary; I'll remain reachable. If degradation persists past 60m escalate to Engineering Manager + Cloud Support.

sre-anna: Taking over. Current status summary for handoff: (1) STS/KMS egress spikes observed; (2) control-plane fallback to eu-west-1 applied and canary healthy; (3) routing policy updated to allow cross-region fallback for select traffic; (4) AWS ticket opened with trace IDs; (5) Support notified customers.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED — Severity set to SEV-2 (third-party egress impacting >5% of region traffic). Paging list updated and postmortem flag set.

deploy-bot: canary finished (3/3 hosts) — sts-fallback config rolled to control-plane.

infra-ben: AWS support responded: "We see elevated egress packet drops in eu-west-3 peering path; mitigation ETA unknown. We recommend rerouting traffic to eu-west-1/2 where possible."

sre-anna: Next steps: continue mitigation (keep cross-region fallback enabled), monitor error rate for 30m. If error rate <1% for 30m, start gradual rollback of emergency config.

oncall-ryan: Leaving now — thanks team.

support-luis: I'll hold on sending final customer update after 30m check.

product-zoe: Adding note: consider adding automated fallback in routing plane for future similar egress provider issues (postmortem action).

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: ongoing. Last update logged at 1768503069.
